QuestInfo.name: The Call of Athena
QuestInfo.0: So Akechi Mitsuhide has been in communication with the Black Wings... The implications of this are serious.
QuestInfo.1: The world will be in grave danger if the Oda clan are allowed to forge an alliance with the Black Wings. Get back to Henesys and tell Athena Pierce immediately.
QuestInfo.2: Athena Pierce has vowed to gather reinforcements from around Maple World to combat any potential alliance between the Black Wings and the Oda Clan. She seems to be a powerful leader.

0.0: Akechi Mitsuhide wants help from the Black Wings? Nobunaga's ambitions have grown. He must seek to control both Sokoku and this new land.
0.1: Nobunaga must be curbed like the rabid dog he is. I must return to the green-eyed archer and tell her of the danger she is in.
